2608.13345.title: Rules or Character? Scaling Laws for AI Safety Design
2608.13345.paper_summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) safety systems combine character shaping (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback [RLHF], Constitutional AI), which modifies behavioral distributions at training time, with rule enforcement (e.g., output filters, safety classifiers), which blocks harmful outputs at inference time, yet little formal analysis exists on how their optimal balance should change as deployment scales increase. We introduce a stylized comparative-statics model that parameterizes safety design as a resource allocation alpha in [0,1] between these two approaches, incorporating scale-dependent filter degradation, common-mode failures, and character fragility -- the risk that shaped behavior degrades or collapses under novel conditions. Under a multiplicative Pareto damage model, we derive closed-form expected harm and supplement it with tail-risk (CVaR) analysis via Monte Carlo simulation. Across three scenarios (optimistic, moderate, pessimistic), the optimal alpha* is interior or at the rules-only boundary and shifts weakly toward character shaping as deployment scale T grows, from negligible (Delta alpha* = +0.01) to pronounced (Delta alpha* = +0.21) depending on scenario. The dominant parameter is the baseline character fragility rate p^(0)_frag, which shifts alpha* by 0.50 across its range -- far exceeding the effect of tail severity, filter quality, or common-mode failure probability. CVaR and expected-harm optima converge at large T. These results suggest that safety architecture decisions depend less on deployment scale per se than on the reliability of character shaping under distributional shift.
2608.13345.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）安全系統結合了角色塑造（例如，來自人類反饋的強化學習 [RLHF]、憲法 AI），這在訓練時修改行為分佈，以及規則執行（例如，輸出過濾器、安全分類器），這在推理時阻止有害輸出，但對於隨著部署規模增加，這兩者的最佳平衡應如何改變，卻缺乏正式的分析。我們引入了一個風格化的比較靜態模型，將安全設計參數化為在這兩種方法之間的資源分配 alpha 在 [0,1] 之內，並納入規模依賴的過濾器退化、共模故障和角色脆弱性——即在新條件下塑造行為退化或崩潰的風險。在乘法帕累托損害模型下，我們推導出封閉形式的預期傷害，並通過蒙特卡羅模擬補充尾風險（CVaR）分析。在三種情境（樂觀、中立、悲觀）下，最佳的 alpha* 位於內部或僅限於規則的邊界，並隨著部署規模 T 的增長，微弱地向角色塑造偏移，從微不足道（Delta alpha* = +0.01）到明顯（Delta alpha* = +0.21），具體取決於情境。主導參數是基線角色脆弱性率 p^(0)_frag，這在其範圍內將 alpha* 轉移 0.50——遠超過尾部嚴重性、過濾器質量或共模故障概率的影響。在大 T 下，CVaR 和預期傷害的最佳值會收斂。這些結果表明，安全架構決策與其部署規模本身的關係不如與角色塑造在分佈變化下的可靠性相關。
